title: Common Problems
markdown:
| Problem | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| A request hangs forever | no timeout | always pass a timeout | 1.02 |
| `JSONDecodeError` on an error response | the server sent HTML (a 502 page) | check the status and `Content-Type` before parsing | 1.03 |
| A search for `"a&b"` sends two parameters | the value was pasted into the URL | build queries with `urlencode` | 1.05 |
| An id with `/` hits the wrong endpoint | the path segment was not escaped | `quote(value, safe="")` | 1.05 |
| `401` on every request | missing, expired or wrong credentials; key in the wrong header | check the authentication docs; refresh the token | 2.02 |
| Works for an hour, then fails | the access token expired and is never renewed | cache with expiry and a margin; retry once after 401 | 2.02 |
| OAuth callback rejected | state mismatch, or the redirect URI differs from the registered one | keep the state per attempt; register the exact URI | 2.03 |
| "Invalid signature" every time | the canonical string differs from the provider's | log your canonical string and compare with their examples | 2.04 |
| A key appears in the logs | logged URLs, headers or bodies | one redaction step for every log line | 2.05 |
| Items missing or doubled while paging | offset paging over changing data | use cursors, or deduplicate by id | 3.01 |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | calling faster than the limit | honour `Retry-After`; pace with a token bucket | 3.02 |
| Duplicate orders or payments | a `POST` was retried | retry `POST` only with an idempotency key | 3.03, 3.04 |
| Retries make an outage worse | immediate, synchronised retries | exponential backoff with jitter, limited attempts | 3.03 |
| The same data fetched again and again | no caching | `Cache-Control`, `ETag` and `If-None-Match` | 3.05 |
| Fake webhook events accepted | no signature verification | verify every delivery before acting | 4.02 |
| Valid webhooks rejected | verifying re-serialised JSON instead of the raw body | verify the raw bytes | 4.02 |
| An event processed twice | retried deliveries | idempotent processing by event id | 4.03 |
| Old data overwrites new | out-of-order deliveries | versions per object, or fetch the current state | 4.03 |
| Webhooks retried for days | slow handler, or non-2xx for unknown types | answer fast; 200 for unhandled types | 4.03 |
| A sync creates duplicates on rerun | insert instead of upsert | upsert by external id | 5.03 |
| Invoices dated a day off | UTC date used instead of local | convert to the local zone before taking the date | 5.02 |
| Amounts off by a cent | floats for money | integer cents or `Decimal` | 5.02 |
| One bad record blocks every later one | an exception stops the run | dead letters; continue with the next record | 5.04 |
| The sync stopped weeks ago, unnoticed | no monitoring | alert on lag and time since the last success | 5.05 |
| A ctypes call returns garbage or crashes | `argtypes`/`restype` not set, or wrong | declare both from the header | 6.02 |
| Fields read wrong values from a struct | different layout: field order, types, packing | mirror the struct exactly; `_pack_` for packed | 6.03 |
| A crash some time after registering a callback | the callback object was garbage collected | keep a reference while C may call it | 6.04 |
| Works on Windows, wrong on Linux | `long` differs in size | fixed-width types | 6.02 |
